info.description: This API provides a fast and free method for generating UUIDs, supporting various versions including v1, v3, v4, v5, v6, and time-ordered v7. It allows bulk UUID generation with options for namespace and formatting, ideal for developers and websites. No authentication required, rate-limited for fair use.
info.title: UUID Generator API
